faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.desc: Everything you need to know before your visit.

items.q: Do I need a firearms license?
items.a: No, you do not need a firearms license for experience shooting. A professional instructor will attend to you the entire time.

items.q: Can I bring my own weapon?
items.a: Yes, if you hold a firearms license, you can bring your own weapon and ammunition.

items.q: From what age is shooting possible?
items.a: Shooting is possible from 18 years of age. For youth from 12 to 18 years, shooting is possible exclusively accompanied by and with the consent of a legal guardian.

items.q: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a: Yes, for the general public (without a firearms license) it is necessary to book a specific date in advance.
